rules.statement: An action for declaration of title to the office of Viharadhipathi can be continued by or against the successor-in-title upon the death of the plaintiff or defendant.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) That in an action for declaration of title to the office of Viharadhipathi of a temple, on the death of the plaintiff or the defendant (if he too claimed to be the Viharadipathi) the action can be continued by or against the successor-in-title under section 404. The maxim actio personalis moritur cum persona will not apply in such a case to abate the action. The action though in form an action for a status or an office is in substance an action for a temple and the temporalities which by operation of law belong to the Viharadipathi of the temple.
